tasks.label: seed-demo-fixed

tasks.label: inspect-vite-processes
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173,5174 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique

tasks.label: inspect-vite-process-details
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173,5174 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess

tasks.label: inspect-vite-process-commands
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = 16280 OR ProcessId = 22868 OR ProcessId = 24200" | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine

tasks.label: inspect-vite-process-ids
tasks.command: Get-Process -Id 16280,22868,24200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path

tasks.label: stop-phase2-vite-servers
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Id 16280,22868,24200; 'Stopped temporary Vite test servers.'

tasks.label: stop-phase3-preview
tasks.command: $listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $ids = $listeners | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($id in $ids) { $process = Get-Process -Id $id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($process -and $process.ProcessName -eq 'node') { Stop-Process -Id $id } }; 'Stopped the temporary Vite preview server.'
